RULE-1 HAZARD WORTH FLAGGING TO THE MERGE: Q27 (p04) and Q35 (p06) are both Match Lists whose Code blocks print the SAME four rows -- 2413 / 2143 / 3142 / 3421 -- but in DIFFERENT label order. Anyone copying one block onto the other produces a right-text/wrong-letter key that no downstream check can catch. TWO-COLUMN READING ORDER, p04: the page's flow is NOT column-major throughout -- Q25's stem and option block sit in the LEFT column BELOW Q24, physically alongside Q27's Code block in the right column, and the OCR text layer interleaves them (it emits Q26, Q27's lists, 'Code :', then Q25 entire, then Q27's code rows). The same hazard recurs at the FOOT of p06, where the OCR layer interleaves Q36's (c)/(d) with Q39's (a)-(d) line by line ('(c) Conservation and management of / (a) P / marine resources / (b) < P / (d) Navigation of ships and laying / (c) > P / down submarine cables / (d) 2P'); on the page Q36's tail is in the left column and Q39's options in the right, and they are assigned accordingly. Pages carry printed numbers 9, 11, 13 -- consecutive PDF indices map to odd printed pages only, so this PDF holds the English half of the bilingual booklet with the Hindi versos removed; that is expected, not a gap.
